actions.text:
Hi Marcus — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. This project sounds like a great fit.

I’m available to build an analytics dashboard with real-time visualizations, REST API integration, auth and role-based access, responsive layouts for tablet/desktop, and dark mode. A few quick questions so I can scope this precisely:

• Do you have realtime data pushed via WebSockets/Server-Sent Events, or will we poll the REST API? 
• Are there existing API docs I can review (auth method, rate limits, sample payloads)?
• How many distinct user roles and dashboards/views do you expect initially?
• Do you have a preference for charting libraries (D3, Recharts, Chart.js, or custom D3 work)?
• Who would handle hosting and deployment, and do you require CI/CD integration?

Based on the budget and a ~4 week timeline, I can prepare a proposed breakdown (milestones, deliverables, and timeline) after a short discovery call. I’m available for a 30-minute call most weekdays between 10:00–15:00 CT next week — let me know what times work for you and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Looking forward to learning more and discussing next steps.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer — TechCorp Inc.
